mostWorthwhile.text: Raising the potato collar and adding medium was the most worthwhile passage: the two steps made clear how developing tubers stay dark while leaves remain exposed to light.

leastWorthwhile.text: The soybean support was useful but especially predictable; there was little to decide once the mesh and unsupported row were visible.

surprise.text: Nothing in this short chapter was particularly surprising; the results followed the visible needs.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: each addressed an explicitly stated growing-bed need.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, cautiously: the practical growing details are interesting, though this chapter's combinations offered little challenge.
